name: data.gouv.fr API (udata)
summary: Keyless REST API of data.gouv.fr, the French national open data platform: datasets, resources, organisations, reuses and spatial zones.
description: The udata API behind data.gouv.fr returns metadata for open datasets published by French ministries, agencies, local authorities and citizens, with resource download URLs, organisation records, tags and reuses. A dataset search for 'velib' matched 11 datasets at check. Swagger 2.0 spec is published and lists 181 paths.

auth.notes: Reads need no key; writes need an account key.

rate_limit.summary: Not documented on the pages fetched.

license.name: Licence Ouverte / Open Licence (platform default; each dataset sets its own)

agent_notes: Responses are large: the dataset object carries full descriptions and every resource, so keep page_size small. Dataset ids can be the hex id or the slug. The resources[].url fields point at the actual CSV/JSON files, often on other hosts. Most free text is in French.
caveats: Per-dataset licence ids vary (fr-lo, odc-odbl, notspecified ...).
Rate limits and terms of API use were not found in the docs fetched; terms page only confirms the Licence Ouverte for the platform's own content.

verification.notes: Exact example request executed without a key; organizations, spatial zones, tags and dataset detail endpoints also returned 200.
